verdict.rationale: BigCommerce exposes webhooks and REST/GraphQL APIs described as letting developers "automate store processes" (bigcommerce-docs-5, bigcommerce-docs-25, bigcommerce-docs-26), which could underpin background automations, but there is no dedicated workflow/automation engine, scheduler, or AI-agent orchestration feature shown, and the discovered MCP endpoint is explicitly a docs-only server, not a store-operations automation surface (bigcommerce-probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: a documented automation/workflow builder, evidence of autonomous scheduled or event-driven jobs beyond raw webhooks, and any AI-agent-specific automation tooling.
